usage: 滑鼠墊 is a noun and refers to the pad used under a computer mouse.
You can use 滑鼠墊 to improve mouse movement precision.
In a sentence, 滑鼠墊 is usually the object or subject.
You can say '我買咗個滑鼠墊' (I bought a mouse pad).
滑鼠墊 often appears with verbs like 擺 (to put) or 用 (to use).
